authority: Built-in Python catalog; documentation export, not runtime permissions

queries.description: Whether Cartesian axes have been homed/zeroed and have an established coordinate reference
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Distinct lowercase x/y/z characters; empty string means no axes homed; absent/invalid is unknown

queries.description: Measured heater and sensor temperatures in Celsius
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Finite numeric Celsius >= -273.15; sensors and targets distinguished

queries.description: Requested heater setpoints, not a request to heat
examples: What is the bed set to?
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Finite numeric Celsius >= 0; setpoint only, never request heating

queries.description: Current heater output fraction as percent
examples: How much heater power is being used?
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Finite fraction 0..1, formatted as percent

queries.description: Last commanded machine position, not measured physical position
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: At least three finite Cartesian coordinates in mm; last commanded, not measured; homing uncertainty labeled

queries.description: G-code coordinates and origin offsets
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Finite XYZ values in mm; G-code origin and configured coordinates distinguished

queries.description: Requested interpolated motion, not encoder-measured motion
examples: How fast is the toolhead moving?
queries.missing: Report unavailable/unsupported; never invent values or run a command
queries.validation: Finite requested interpolated coordinates/velocity; no encoder or physical motion claim

queries.description: Runtime velocity, acceleration and cornering limits
